name: Service-Mesh Scalability Benchmark Dataset
description: Service-Mesh Scalability Benchmark Dataset: Fortio Tail-Latency Measurements for Federated and Peer-to-Peer IoT-to-Cloud Microservice Scenarios on Istio/Kubernetes Raw benchmark measurements and analysis code characterising the scalability of the Istio service mesh across six representative IoT-to-cloud microservice scenarios. The data underpin the two-axis benchmarking taxonomy introduced in the associated article, and are released so that the reported latency distributions can be independently recomputed and reused. What is measured Fifty-two Fortio load-generation phases were executed against an Istio-meshed Kubernetes cluster, spanning offered rates from 1 to 400 queries per second and concurrency from 2 to 200 threads. Each phase records the full latency histogram, percentile summary (P50, P90, P99, P99.9), requested versus achieved throughput, HTTP response-code counts, and connection-establishment statistics. Fifty-one phases enter the analysis; one low-load cold-start run is archived but excluded under a documented validity rule. Two-axis design Runs are labelled along two independent axes. Axis A — scale tier (A1 Baseline, A2 Moderate, A3 High, A4 Extreme), derived from offered rate and concurrency, with demonstrated saturation forcing the Extreme tier.
